name: Out of the Tombs
oracle_text:
At the beginning of your upkeep, put two eon counters on this enchantment, then mill cards equal to the number of eon counters on it.
If you would draw a card while your library has no cards in it, instead return a creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield. If you can't, you lose the game.
blocked_sentences: If you would draw a card while your library has no cards in it, instead return a creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield. If you can't, you lose the game.

needs.what: a player-wide static replacing a draw from an empty library with an arbitrary effect list (here: the player chooses a creature card in their own graveyard and puts it onto the battlefield), with a fallback effect when that cannot be done (lose_game for that player) -- the static would carry `effects` and an `else`/`if_cant` branch read in replacements._draw_one
needs.why_existing_wont_do: replace_empty_draw is a yes/no that substitutes only winning the game (wins_on_empty_draw; the loader refuses any size or affects), replace_draw only multiplies the draw count, and the packet notes say a draw replacement that does something other than draw more cards is still a gap. A draw-triggered ability would not replace the draw, so the empty-library loss would still happen.
